places.name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
places.description: UNESCO World Heritage site and iconic Mughal architecture masterpiece. Explore the grand halls and beautiful gardens.

places.name: Jama Masjid
places.description: India's largest mosque built by Shah Jahan. Marvel at the stunning architecture and panoramic city views from the minaret.

places.name: Raj Ghat (Gandhi Memorial)
places.description: Memorial dedicated to Mahatma Gandhi. A peaceful spot for reflection amidst beautiful gardens.

places.name: India Gate
places.description: War memorial dedicated to Indian soldiers. Perfect for photos with the iconic monument.

places.name: Rashtrapati Bhavan (President's House)
places.description: Official residence of the President of India. Photo stop to admire the grand colonial architecture.

places.name: Qutub Minar
places.description: UNESCO World Heritage site. World's tallest brick minaret showcasing Indo-Islamic architecture.

places.name: Humayun's Tomb
places.description: Magnificent Mughal tomb and UNESCO World Heritage site. Inspiration for the Taj Mahal's design.

sightseeing_packages.transport_details: Air-conditioned sedan (Toyota Etios / Similar) with experienced driver
sightseeing_packages.meal_details: Lunch at a popular local restaurant (Vegetarian and Non-vegetarian options)
sightseeing_packages.notes: Comfortable walking shoes recommended. Friday is closed for Jama Masjid. Camera charges at monuments are extra if you want to carry professional cameras.

exclusions: Hotel pickup/drop (can be arranged at extra cost)
